notes: Cargo edges include all declared local optional, target, build and dev dependencies, not a resolved feature configuration. Reviewed data dependencies are separately labeled.
Python import edges are static AST references to local source modules; dynamic imports and the native extension are not resolved.
Flow edges are reviewed policy annotations, not extracted call graphs. File containment does not imply test coverage.

Inventory covers Git-visible source/config/docs in explicit roots plus named root entry points, including untracked candidate source. Reference datasets, binary fixtures, ignored untracked files, symlinks and build artifacts are excluded; commit intended new inputs with generated maps.

agent.requires: Python 3.11+; no third-party dependencies or network

core.requires: Rust and cached Cargo dependencies; historical fixture integration tests are separate

hmm.requires: Rust, C compiler, make, libclang, verified HMMER source or network; see docs/BUILDING.md

learned.requires: Rust and cached dependencies; bounded synthetic codec/decoder contracts, without Candle or historical fixtures. Model features and biological fixture suites require separate review

commands: cargo test --locked -p anarci-learned --test codec --test decode --test augment --test data
learned-fixtures.requires: Opt-in only after reviewing and authorizing historical tests/fixtures/golden.json.gz provenance and use; these tests read that fixture, including tests named augmentation and decoder. Not a release qualification or trained-model accuracy check

packaging.requires: Python; source extraction tests, not wheel qualification

python.requires: Isolated Python environment, maturin and native build prerequisites; rebuild extension after Rust edits

release.requires: Follow docs/RELEASING.md for actual artifact qualification; --help does not validate a release; notices check needs dependency sources cached
